await page.evaluate('async () => { const wait=()=>new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,100)); window.originalFetch=window.fetch; const snapshot=await (await fetch(\'/flightdeck.json\')).json(); window.fixtureSnapshot=snapshot; const base=snapshot.repos[0]; snapshot.repos=Array.from({length:8},(_,i)=>({...base,id:\'github.com/fixture/repo-\'+i,name:\'Fixture \'+i})); let calls=0; window.fetch=async()=>{calls++; await wait();return {ok:true,json:async()=>snapshot}}; document.querySelector(\'#retry\').click();document.querySelector(\'#retry\').click(); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,300)); if(calls!==1)throw Error(\'overlapping reads\'); if(document.querySelectorAll(\'.repo-card\').length!==8)throw Error(\'missing eighth repo\'); const card=document.querySelector(\'.repo-card\');card.scrollTop=150;card.focus();document.querySelector(\'#retry\').click();await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,300));if(document.querySelector(\'.repo-card\').scrollTop!==150)throw Error(\'scroll lost\');if(document.activeElement.dataset.cardId!==base.id && document.activeElement.dataset.cardId!==\'github.com/fixture/repo-0\')throw Error(\'focus lost\'); window.fetch=async()=>{throw Error(\'offline fixture\')};for(let i=0;i<3;i++){document.querySelector(\'#retry\').click();await wait();} const status=document.querySelector(\'#connectionStatus\').textContent;if(!status.includes(\'polling paused\'))throw Error(\'failure hidden\');if(document.querySelector(\'.source-pill.ok\'))throw Error(\'stale feed green\');if(!document.querySelector(\'#retry\').getBoundingClientRect().width)throw Error(\'retry hidden\');window.fetch=window.originalFetch;document.querySelector(\'#retry\').click();await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,400));if(document.querySelector(\'#connectionStatus\').textContent.includes(\'failed\'))throw Error(\'recovery failed\');return {eightRepos:true,singleFlight:true,scrollAndFocusPreserved:true,threeFailuresVisible:true,manualRecovery:true}; }');
